glosses: Alternative form of -fucking-, used when the infix is put between two words.

examples.text: New Fucking York.
She had been, as I say, drinking all afternoon and she suddenly howled, “Ten o’clock! It’s ten o’fucking clock! Why doesn’t he come? Why in God’s name doesn’t he come?” Something along those lines.

glosses: Causing awe or terror; inspiring wonder or excitement.

examples.text: The waterfall in the middle of the rainforest was an awesome sight.
